facts.statement: Excavations for the Japan-Thailand Dinosaur Project took place between 2007 and 2009 at the village of Saphan Hin in Nakhon Ratchasima Province.
facts.quote: Between 2007 and 2009, the Japan-Thailand Dinosaur Project carried out excavations at the village of Saphan Hin, subdistrict Suranaree, Mueang Nakhon Ratchasima District, in Nakhon Ratchasima Province.

facts.statement: The species Siamraptor suwati was named and described in 2019 by Duangsuda Chokchaloemwon, Soki Hattori, Elena Cuesta, Pratueng Jintasakul, Masateru Shibata, and Yoichi Azuma.
facts.quote: In 2019, the type species Siamraptor suwati was named and described by Duangsuda Chokchaloemwon, Soki Hattori, Elena Cuesta, Pratueng Jintasakul, Masateru Shibata and Yoichi Azuma.

facts.statement: The generic name Siamraptor combines "Siam", the former name of Thailand, and the Latin word raptor meaning "robber".
facts.quote: The generic name is derived from "Siam", the former name of Thailand, and the Latin word raptor ("robber").

facts.statement: The holotype specimen NRRU-F01020008 was found in the Aptian-aged Khok Kruat Formation.
facts.quote: The holotype, NRRU-F01020008, was found in a layer of the Khok Kruat Formation dating from the Aptian.

facts.statement: Siamraptor is estimated to have been 7.9 to 8 meters long, 2.4 meters tall, and weighed 1500 kilograms.
facts.quote: La longitud corporal de Siamraptor ha sido estimada entre unos 7,9 a 8 metros, una altura de 2,4 metros y un peso de 1500 kilogramos.

facts.statement: The jugal bone has a straight lower edge instead of a convex or undulating one, and its front branch is high even under the eye socket.
facts.quote: El hueso yugal tiene un borde inferior que es recto en lugar de convexo u ondulado mientras que el ramo frontal es alto, incluso bajo la cuenca ocular.

facts.statement: The surangular bone has a deep oval excavation at the rear and four rear surangular foramina, whereas other theropods possess at most two.
facts.quote: El hueso surangular tiene una perforación profunda oval en la parte posterior de dicho hueso y cuatro forámenes posteriores surangulares, mientras que otros terópodos poseían como mucho dos.

facts.statement: A long narrow groove runs along the suture between the surangular and prearticular bones.
facts.quote: Un largo y estrecho surco corre a lo largo de la sutura entre surangular y el prearticular.

facts.statement: The front neck vertebra possesses an additional pneumatic foramen excavating the parapophysis, the lower rib contact.
facts.quote: La vértebra frontal del cuello posee un foramen neumático adicional que excava la parapófisis, el contacto inferior con la costilla.

facts.statement: Siamraptor lived during the mid-Cretaceous, between 120 and 112 million years ago in the Aptian stage, in what is now Asia.
facts.quote: que vivió a mediados del período Cretácico, entre 120a 112 millones de años, durante el Aptiense, en lo que es hoy Asia.

facts.statement: Siamraptor lived from 121.4 to 113.2 million years ago during the Aptian.
facts.quote: Time range: Aptian to Aptian (121.4 to 113.2 million years ago)

facts.statement: Siamraptor has generally been classified as a member of Carcharodontosauria.
facts.quote: Siamraptor has generally been recovered as a member of Carcharodontosauria.

facts.statement: In 2026, Hattori and colleagues provisionally referred two partial braincases from the Khok Kruat Formation to Siamraptor, the only named carcharodontosaur from that formation.
facts.quote: In 2026, Hattori and colleagues described two partial braincases from the Khok Kruat Formation that they provisionally referred to Siamraptor, the only named carcharodontosaur from the formation, despite no overlap with the holotype.

facts.statement: In a 2024 review, Cau recovered Siamraptor as a tetanuran outside the Orionides and as a close relative of Siamotyrannus.
facts.quote: In his 2024 review of theropod relationships, Cau recovered it as a tetanuran outside of the Orionides, as a close relative of Siamotyrannus.

facts.statement: According to Ezcurra and Agnolin, the existence of Siamraptor would indicate that Laurasian landmasses were connected until the Barremian, though its basal position does not strictly rule out early isolation.
facts.quote: Su existencia, según Ezcurra y Agnolin, indicaría que las masas de tierra de Laurasia estaban conectadas hasta el Barremiense, aunque la posición muy basal no descarta estrictamente el aislamiento temprano.

facts.statement: The assigned fossils represent at least three individuals of different sizes.
facts.quote: Los fósiles asignados representan al menos tres individuos de diferentes tamaños.

rejected.statement: Siamraptor is an extinct genus of carcharodontosaurian dinosaur that includes the single species S. suwati.
rejected.quote: Siamraptor is an extinct genus of carcharodontosaurian dinosaur, containing the single species S. suwati, known from the Khok Kruat Formation of Thailand.
